firstConcept.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create one polished initial logo concept for the logistics software brand "FreteNow", to review with its founder before a brandbook is finalized.
Single clean horizontal logo lockup, centered with generous negative space on a uniform very light cool gray background #F2F4F8. This is a single logo presentation, not a collage, mood board, guidelines sheet, device mockup, or website.
Desired feeling: the calm confidence, clarity, friendliness and organized efficiency of a modern freight management application. Professional and approachable, compact and practical. No aggressive speed effects or flashy futuristic styling.
Symbol: a compact distinctive geometric freight/package mark, subtly combining the structure of a parcel with a forward-moving route or F construction. Simple flat shapes, deliberate negative space, readable at small sizes. Main colors deep navy #0A1F4E, vivid blue #0177FD and a restrained sky-blue #7DB8FF accent. No gradients, shadows, texture or 3D.
Wordmark: exact text "FreteNow", capital F and N, one word. Friendly confident contemporary sans-serif with the slightly characterful broad shapes of Bricolage Grotesque, balanced with the clarity of Instrument Sans. Excellent optical spacing. "Frete" in deep navy and "Now" in vivid blue, consistent weight and baseline. Symbol approximately the cap height to slightly taller, placed left of the wordmark.
No extra words, no slogan, no captions, no registered/trademark symbol, no alternate logos, no extra panels. Keep the whole mark spacious and elegantly balanced. Crisp vector-like edges in this raster concept.
